question:
An **ideal** $LC$ oscillator uses an inductor $L=10\,\mu\text{H}$. It is tuned to frequency $f_1=100\,\text{kHz}$ by choosing a capacitor $C_1$.

The capacitor is charged to $V_0=10\,\text{V}$ (dc) and then connected to the inductor (initial current zero). Later, the capacitor is replaced by another capacitor $C_2$ (same inductor) so that the oscillation frequency becomes $f_2=50\,\text{kHz}$. This new capacitor is also charged to the same $V_0=10\,\text{V}$ and then connected.

Find (i) $C_1$ and (ii) the maximum current $I_{\max,2}$ in the second oscillation.
